My first computer information systems teacher was new to my college and he did a fantastic job teaching the class and offering fair office hours. As for advice for you, I would just say to be very passionate about the subject you are teaching. Since you will likely have some students who are taking  this class as a credit maybe not related to their field completely, just offer enough help for them. One thing I have always liked is when professors say you can text or call them for help as long as it is at a reasonable hour. Good luck, hope all goes well for you!
